## Which agent host

Which agent you were using, and its version if you know it.

## Which part

The file or node — an employee, a principle, the workflow, a board adapter,
the log.

## What you asked for

## What the agent did

## What you expected instead

## Did the agent read the skill at all?

If you can tell, say so. **Often you cannot**, and that is a known limitation
rather than something to guess at — no host reports whether a skill was loaded
or followed. An answer of "no idea" is a useful answer here.
